KIT landed the level kit as documented in ARCHITECTURE.md '### Level kit (KIT)' and docs/milestones/M5-calls/KIT.md: LevelRoot (group level_root) API player, director, spawner, nav_region, sections, player_start, player_yaw_deg, enemies(), arenas(), current_arena(), route_points(), first_route_point(arena), next_target(arena) (INF after the last), start_at_arena(index) (index 0 stands the player at Start, later ones at the arena's first route point). In KIT's recording the controls-help panel and the combat-log panel cover much of the first-person view: make sure your acts show the plain first-person view the crowd bot shows (find how crowd_bot.gd hides or skips them) so Game-boy and the reviewers judge the level, not the panels. tools/record_acts.sh already has the lead's fallback that cuts plain overview sheets (sheets/overview_NN.png) for acts without LOOK-MARK lines: keep it when you add BOT_SCENE.
